title: Too Much Glue
author: Jason Lefebvre
intro: Matty loves glue more than anything! At home with Dad, he makes all kinds of fun things out of glue.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.q: What does Matty love to use?
questions.clue: It is sticky and comes in a squeeze bottle.

questions.q: Who makes glue projects with Matty at home?
questions.clue: This parent loves glue just as much as Matty does.
questions.yes: Matty and his dad make glue projects at home.

questions.q: What does the art teacher tell the class to make with glue?
questions.clue: She wants them to use tiny drops of glue.
questions.yes: The art teacher tells them to use glue raindrops instead of puddles.

questions.q: Why does the art teacher warn against using too much glue?
questions.clue: She worries it will stay wet forever.
questions.yes: The art teacher warns that too much glue never dries.

questions.q: Where does Matty make a giant puddle of glue?

options.text: On the table in art class

questions.clue: He makes a giant puddle of glue on his workspace.
questions.yes: Matty pours a giant puddle of glue onto the art table.

questions.q: What does Matty do after pouring the glue on the table?

options.text: He belly-flops right into the glue
He hides underneath his wooden chair
He washes his hands in the sink

questions.clue: He jumps onto the table to make himself part of the art.
questions.yes: Matty belly-flops onto the glue-covered table.

questions.q: Why does Matty stay on the table when he tries to get up?

options.text: He is stuck in the glue
He is too tired to stand

questions.clue: The sticky mess pulls him right back down.
questions.yes: Matty is stuck in the glue and boings right back down.

questions.q: What happens when Matty's friends try to pull him out with yarn?

options.text: The yarn breaks and sticks to him
The table tips over onto the floor

questions.clue: The string snaps and becomes part of the sticky mess.
questions.yes: The yarn lassoes snap and get stuck to Matty.

questions.q: What happens to the toy tow truck that tries to pull Matty out?

options.text: Its wheels roll out the door
Its battery runs out of power

questions.clue: The brick truck breaks and sticks to the glue too.
questions.yes: The tow truck snaps apart and the bricks stick to Matty.

questions.q: How does the art teacher feel when Matty is stuck?
questions.clue: She breathes very fast and fans herself because she is so worried.
questions.yes: The art teacher is panicked and hyperventilating.

questions.q: Why do the children fan Matty?
questions.clue: Moving air helps wet glue harden.
questions.yes: They fan Matty so that the glue will dry.

questions.q: Who finally peels Matty off the art table?
questions.clue: He arrives at school when the bell rings to take Matty home.
questions.yes: Matty's dad peels the dried glue off the table.

questions.q: How does Matty's dad feel when he sees Matty covered in dried glue?
questions.yes: Matty's dad is pleased and calls him a masterpiece.

questions.q: Where does Dad put Matty's dried glue suit at home?

options.text: On the fridge with a magnet

questions.clue: It is where parents often hang up their children's artwork in the kitchen.
questions.yes: Dad puts a magnet on the glue suit and sticks it to the fridge.

questions.q: What does the family play with after dinner instead of glue?
questions.clue: It comes on a roll and is also very sticky.
questions.yes: After dinner, the family plays with duct tape.
